role: Extension of AssistantTurnRouter (the view model's routing subsystem): chooses the provider/model/tier per turn around the pure TurnRouter, and drives a dispatched turn through pre-flight metrics, context+tool assembly, system-prompt composition, the tool loop with error/fallback policy, and post-stream effects (CoachVoiceGuard scrub, auto-fact extraction).
types: AssistantTurnRouter.TurnRoute: struct — provider/model/tier/voiceMode for one turn
AssistantTurnRouter.AssembledContext: struct — rendered context, outbound turns, tools, fact registry
AssistantTurnRouter.StreamAttempt: struct — inputs of one provider attempt
state: static AssistantTurnRouter.emailVerbPhrases ("email me/this/that/it/him/her/them": email used as a verb with its object, read by messageRequiresTools)
toplevel: Nested struct declarations and the static emailVerbPhrases list outside units.

units.does: Builds TurnRouter inputs, adds the tier stage only when TurnRouter.needsTierProposal says the turn reaches tier routing, runs the pure TurnRouter.route, logs its lines, and returns the live provider for the decided id plus model and tier.

Snapshots each provider's availability (isAvailable && feature-flag enabled), consent, tool support and default-or-first model, plus routing mode, active provider/model, whether the active provider can take a turn (ProviderRegistry.canSend), voice flag and provider order into TurnRouter.Inputs.

Impure tier stage: proposes a tier for the mode, snapshots mappings, records/checks the Tier-3 daily cap only when the proposal is Deep and Deep maps to a non-Apple provider, and computes messageRequiresTools for the latest user turn.

branches.effect: messageRequiresTools(msg) else false when there is no user turn

units.does: Maps routing mode to a tier: quick→.quick, deep→.deep, auto→classifies the latest user turn with SmartProviderRouter.route (bumping turnCount and storing currentTier), manual→nil.

branches.effect: return nil (documented unreachable since needsTierProposal is false for manual)

units.does: Builds mapping snapshots for the proposed tier and, for Deep, also for .auto (the cap downgrade target), each passed through enabledMappingSnapshot.
Returns the mapper's provider/model, but replaces it with Apple's default model (collapsed=true) when the mapped provider is switched off in Settings and Apple is available with a model.

branches.cond: mapped provider enabled OR Apple unavailable OR Apple has no model

units.does: Returns the active provider instance when its id matches, otherwise the registry provider with that id, else the active provider.
True for every provider except Apple.

Keyword heuristic for action intents: 'email' with send/draft/compose/forward, 'email' used as a verb with its object right after it (emailVerbPhrases: email me/this/that/it/him/her/them), send-to phrases, contact add/remove, directions, save/rename route, or web-search phrasing. A settings question such as "what are the email defaults for this" does not count.

branches.cond: save this route OR (rename AND route)

units.does: True when text contains "look up " but not "look up my " (the user's own data is answered by the app's tools), or another web-search phrase ('search the web', 'look it up', 'latest news', 'current weather', etc.).

branches.cond: "look up " present and not "look up my "
branches.effect: true; else the phrase list decides.

units.does: Routes the turn. When the routed provider cannot take it (ProviderRegistry.canSend: no key, unavailable, or switched off) sets the unavailable error and, for a new message, takes back the user turn send() appended (withdrawTrailingUserTurn) and hands a typed one back to the input bar; a regeneration changes nothing. Then applies the consent last-gate (passing the regeneration along), removes the reply being regenerated (by id) and saves, and starts the stream (startStream).

branches.cond: routed provider cannot take the turn
a new message (not a regeneration) whose user turn ends the thread
branches.effect: withdraw it; when the turn was typed, put its text back in the input bar

branches.cond: regenerating and the reply is still there

units.does: Reserves the assistant placeholder for the routed provider/model/tier, sets isStreaming and clears the error, bumps streamGeneration, cancels any prior stream task and starts a Task running runDispatchedTurn for this generation.

Dispatch task body: refresh training metrics, assemble context/tools from the history before this turn's placeholder, compose the system prompt (toolMode = tools non-empty), run the stream under the error policy (which reports whether the reply completed normally), drop an empty assistant turn; then, if the generation is still current, report an empty reply when the turn was dropped (reportEmptyReply) and finishCurrentTurn with that completion flag (Apple dispatcher release + post-stream effects); finally finishStream, which may drain a send queued during the stream. Checking the generation before finishStream keeps a queued send's dispatch from making this completed turn look stale.

branches.cond: streamGeneration still this turn's (no Stop, no newer send)
branches.effect: the steps below; else skip them (a cancelled/superseded turn gets no post-stream effects and no empty-reply error).

branches.cond: the empty assistant turn was dropped

units.does: For a current-generation turn that left no text: when no error explains it (errorMessage nil) and the task is not cancelled, logs a warning and sets errorMessage to 'No answer came back from the AI. Try asking again.', so the chat banner shows it and voice mode speaks its recovery line instead of going silent.

branches.cond: an error is already set, or the task is cancelled

units.does: End of a turn that is still the current generation: releases the Apple tool dispatcher's registry after an Apple turn, then applies the post-stream effects (final CoachVoiceGuard scrub; background fact extraction only when completed, i.e. the reply completed normally).
Removes the reserved assistant turn and saves when it still exists and its text is blank; returns whether it removed the turn.

branches.cond: turn missing OR not assistant OR has text
branches.effect: returns false; else removes, saves and returns true

units.does: Resolves provider/model/tier, consumes the one-shot nextSendIsVoice flag, logs a warning when the routed provider differs from the saved active provider, returns a TurnRoute.

Returns true if the routed provider needs no consent. Otherwise: for a regeneration (replyID set) removes nothing and holds the request as a regeneration of the latest user question (pendingConsentRequest regenerate: true, not voice); for a new message takes back the trailing user turn (withdrawTrailingUserTurn, which saves so a relaunch does not bring it back) and holds it in pendingConsentRequest (provider, text, voice, regenerate: false); logs, and returns false. send() and regenerateLast() check the active provider's consent first and routing moves turns only to consented providers, so this is a last guard that should not fire.

branches.cond: a regeneration with a user question
branches.effect: hold it as a regeneration; nothing removed

branches.cond: a new message whose user turn ends the thread
branches.effect: withdraw it and hold it; else only log

units.does: When the thread ends on a user turn, removes it, saves the history and returns its text; nil otherwise.

branches.cond: thread does not end on a user turn

units.does: Appends an empty assistant ChatTurn tagged with provider id, model apiID, subsystem .coach and routed tier; returns its index and id.
Returns the current index of the turn with the given id, or nil.
Awaits TrainingMetricsCache.refresh() so tool answers match the dashboard.

Renders compact context only for Apple, takes the history before the turn's reserved placeholder (or every turn but the last when the placeholder is gone), so a medical-guard exchange appended after the placeholder is not part of it, truncates it to the provider budget, summarises one budget-sized batch (summaryBatch) of the newly dropped turns, gets the cached registry+tools, begins a registry turn, ranks and caps tools, publishes the registry to the Apple dispatcher (Apple only), logs catalog-hash drift, returns AssembledContext.

branches.effect: compactRender of current context; cloud gets ""
history = turns before it; else all turns but the last
await summarisation of the oldest batch (≤5 s) before sending

units.does: Builds a BM25 query from the last and previous user messages in outbound and returns ToolRetriever.retrieve(targetK 40).

branches.effect: query = last only, else last + prior

units.does: Publishes the fact registry to the Apple tool dispatcher when the provider is Apple.

Sets AssistantSystemPrompt.pendingRecentUserMessages to the last 6 non-localOnly user texts, composes the system prompt (facts, priorSummary, rendered context, compact app reference, voice mode, toolMode as given), clears the pending messages, returns the prompt. Used by the main dispatch and by every fallback (AssistantToolRunner.fallbackSystemPrompt).

Runs the tool-use loop and returns whether the reply completed normally: true when the loop finished; the user's Stop (AssistantToolRunner.isStop: CancellationError, or AIProviderError.cancelled while the task is cancelled) is swallowed (partial reply kept) and returns false; a fallbackable AIProviderError goes to handleFallbackableFailure, whose result (a fallback answered) is returned; any other error — a refusal, or PickedModelFailure after the turn ran a mutating tool — goes to handleStreamFailure (which marks a turn that kept text incomplete) and returns false.

branches.effect: swallowed; partial text kept; return false
return handleFallbackableFailure (true only if a fallback answered)

branches.cond: any other error (refusals, PickedModelFailure, a cancellation that is not a Stop)

units.does: Computes the allowed fallback chain (ordered providers filtered by TurnRouter.failureFallback for mode/selection), logs the primary failure; with no chain surfaces a PickedModelFailure and returns false; else walks the fallbacks (tryFallbacks), surfaces the original error through handleStreamFailure when every fallback failed, and returns true only when a fallback answered.
If the live assistant turn exists and is non-empty, runs the final CoachVoiceGuard scrub, then background fact extraction, which goes ahead only when completed (the reply completed normally).

Final whole-message CoachVoiceGuard pass: if prohibited language is present and the scrub intercepts, replaces the turn text, saves the conversation (so a relaunch can't restore the unscrubbed reply) and logs each trigger.
Logs a CoachVoiceGuard interception reason via os_log (public reason, no user text).

When auto-extract is on and factExtractionExchange returns an exchange (the reply completed normally, is not marked incomplete, and follows a user turn), launches a detached background Task running runAutoFactExtraction with the user and reply texts.

branches.cond: auto-extract disabled OR no exchange to read

units.does: Pure selection of what fact extraction reads after a turn: the (userText, assistantText) of the user turn before assistantIndex and the reply at it. Nil unless completed is true, the index is in range and at least 1, the reply is not marked incomplete, and the turn before it is a user turn.

branches.cond: not completed, index out of range or < 1, or reply incomplete
preceding turn is not a user turn
